exposure: Nonvertex presentation of the second twin
nonvertex presentation of the second twin
vertex presentation of the second twin
cohort: 716 women with vertex-presenting first twins at >32 weeks gestation without contraindication to labor
finding: Patients with nonvertex second twins had comparable, if not higher, rates of vaginal delivery than those with vertex-presenting second twins, suggesting that nonvertex presentation alone should not preclude a trial of labor.
mod_finding: Patients with a vertex-presenting first twin and a nonvertex second twin had comparable rates of vaginal delivery to those with both twins in vertex presentation.
